sql: WITH inst AS ( SELECT id, instance_id, unit, provider, status, is_active, company_id, connected_at FROM wapi_instances WHERE provider = 'evolution' OR company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' ) SELECT 'instancias' AS secao, to_jsonb(i) AS dados FROM inst i UNION ALL SELECT 'saude', jsonb_build_object('key', h.key, 'state', h.state, 'state_since', h.state_since, 'bad', h.bad_checks, 'alerted_state', h.alerted_state, 'alerted_at', h.alerted_at, 'last_check_at', h.last_check_at, 'lock_until', h.lock_until, 'detail', h.detail) FROM provider_health h UNION ALL SELECT 'incidentes', to_jsonb(pi) FROM provider_incidents pi WHERE pi.started_at >= '2026-10-15T00:00:00Z' OR pi.ended_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'cron_jobs', jsonb_build_object('jobid', j.jobid, 'schedule', j.schedule, 'active', j.active, 'cmd', left(j.command, 160)) FROM cron.job j WHERE j.command ILIKE '%evolution-monitor%' UNION ALL SELECT 'cron_runs', jsonb_build_object('hora_utc', date_trunc('hour', d.start_time), 'status', d.status, 'n', count(*), 'msg', left(max(d.return_message), 120)) FROM cron.job_run_details d JOIN cron.job j ON j.jobid = d.jobid WHERE j.command ILIKE '%evolution-monitor%' AND d.start_time BETWEEN '2026-10-16T18:00:00Z' AND '2026-10-17T03:00:00Z' GROUP BY date_trunc('hour', d.start_time), d.status UNION ALL SELECT 'eventos_conexao', jsonb_build_object('at', e.received_at, 'inst', e.instance_id, 'event', e.event_type) FROM wapi_webhook_raw_events e WHERE e.received_at BETWEEN '2026-10-16T18:00:00Z' AND '2026-10-17T03:00:00Z' AND e.event_type NOT IN ('Message', 'Receipt', 'ChatPresence', 'Presence') AND e.instance_id IN (SELECT instance_id FROM inst) UNION ALL SELECT 'envios_hora', jsonb_build_object('unidade', i.unit, 'hora_brt', to_char(m.timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'DD/MM HH24'), 'source', coalesce(m.metadata->>'source', '(sem)'), 'status', m.status, 'n', count(*)) FROM wapi_messages m JOIN wapi_conversations c ON c.id = m.conversation_id JOIN inst i ON i.id = c.instance_id WHERE m.from_me AND i.provider = 'evolution' AND m.timestamp BETWEEN '2026-10-16T03:00:00Z' AND '2026-10-17T03:00:00Z' GROUP BY i.unit, to_char(m.timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'DD/MM HH24'), coalesce(m.metadata->>'source', '(sem)'), m.status
